# Gladstone Land Corporation Earnings Call and Webcast Information


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_9119c497420fd897ffe7638e1991fd20/gladstonefarms/news/2026-11-09_Gladstone_Land_Corporation_Earnings_Call_and_375.pdf) November 09, 2026 8:30am EST


**MCLEAN, VA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 9, 2026 /**[Gladstone Land Corporation](https://pr.report/swu2) (Nasdaq:LAND) announces the following event:


What:


Gladstone Land Corporation's Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026, Earnings Call & Webcast


When:


Wednesday, November 11, 2026 @ 8:30 a.m. ET


Where:


[https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=nvNdQHP3](https://pr.report/swu3)


How:


By webcast -- Log on to the web at the address above


By phone -- Please call (877) 407-9046


Contact:


Gladstone Land Corporation, (703) 287-5893


A conference call replay will be available after the call and will be accessible through November 18, 2026. To hear the replay, please dial (877) 660-6853 and use playback conference number 13762362.


If you are unable to participate during the live webcast, the call will be archived and available for replay on the Company's website,[www.GladstoneLand.com](https://pr.report/swu4) .


Gladstone Land Corporation is a real estate investment trust that specializes in purchasing farms and farm-related properties and leasing them to farmers. Additional information can be found at[www.gladstoneland.com](https://pr.report/swu5) .


For further information: Gladstone Land Corporation, (703) 287-5893


**SOURCE:** Gladstone Land Corporation
